verdict.rationale: Entra exposes its own API surface through Microsoft Graph, which has published $metadata and OpenAPI descriptions, a versioning and support policy, Graph Explorer, and documented operations such as listing users. However, no evidence states or shows that every portal (UI) capability is reachable through the API, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity documentation, evidence that admin features such as Conditional Access, lifecycle workflows, entitlement management and diagnostic settings are fully API-manageable, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Microsoft Entra's API surface is Microsoft Graph, whose machine-readable description is published live
